arguments.code: # Test m2 - footnote handling import markdown md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'footnotes']) result = md.convert('# Header with footnote[^1]\n\n[^1]: text') print('Result:') print(result[:500]) print() print('TOC:', md.toc) print() print('TOC tokens:', md.toc_tokens) # Check that TOC link text doesn't have trailing "1" import re match = re.search(r']*>(.*?)', md.toc) if match: toc_text = match.group(1) print(f"\nTOC link text: {repr(toc_text)}") assert '1' not in toc_text or 'fn' in toc_text.lower(), f"Footnote ref should be removed from TOC text, got: {repr(toc_text)}" print("Footnote refs correctly removed!")
